title: Two defects in one kitchen — sink pipe leak and wall staining, no cross-attribution of cause
why: A leaking sink pipe (observed) and staining to a wall on the other side of the room are two issues. The staining finding must not borrow the leak as its cause at high confidence — the evidence for the leak lives in the other issue and was not given to it.

issues.title: Leaking sink waste
issues.description: Drip from the waste pipe joint under the sink when the tap runs

photos.caption: drip from waste joint under sink

transcripts: Under the sink, waste joint drips when the tap runs, steady. Base of the unit is swollen.

must_not_happen.label: no wall-stain wording in the pipe finding

issues.title: Staining to external wall
issues.description: Brown staining with a tide line to the external wall by the window, far side of the room from the sink

photos.caption: tide line to external wall by window

transcripts: Other side of the kitchen, external wall by the window, brown staining with a tide line about worktop height. Didn't get a reading here.

must_not_happen.label: no sink-leak wording in the wall-stain finding
no high confidence: no reading, one photo

allowed_uncertainty: The stain's cause may be penetrating damp or condensation at low/medium. Naming 'a leak' generically is fine; naming the sink is contamination.
